title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Fifty-One Hundred Sixty-Five By Standardizing the Salaries of Officials in the Bureau of Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Fifty-One Hundred Sixty-Five By Standardizing the Salaries of Officials in the Bureau of Public Works

text.en:
Section two of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 2. Such sums as are necessary to implement the adjustment of salaries provided for by this Act in the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-nine shall be paid out of any savings in the appropriation of the Bureau of Public Works. Thereafter, the sums necessary for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act."
The incumbents of the positions whose salaries are herein standardized shall automatically be entitled to the benefits hereof without the need of extending another appointment.
All Acts, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamations, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, inconsistent with this Act are repealed or amended accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 4, 1969.
